note: A traveller and a villager are the same sixteen boxes in different trousers, which is fine up close — you can read their names — and useless at the distance this camera watches a road from.

The one thing true of a traveller and of nobody else is that they are carrying their house on their back, so that is what the rig says from above: a pack behind the shoulders with a bedroll across the top of it, breaking the outline every other person here shares.

Leather and canvas rather than palette tints. The palettes dress the person — shirt and hair — and a traveller's second tint runs to gold and hot pink. Kit is kit, and it is the same brown on everybody who carries it.

parts.note: narrower than the back it rides on, so it reads as a load on a person and not a second torso
lying across the top of the pack: shorter than the pack is wide, so nothing juts past it
two straps over the shoulder beam, which is what stops the pack looking stuck on
